title: Travelers Want 'Plot Twist Trips' to Show Their Wild Side
paragraphs: Emily loves city breaks. She loves going to the spa, eating in nice restaurants and drinking wine with a beautiful view of the city.
But Emily's next vacation is a hiking trip in the jungle. She'll be sleeping in a tent, eating basic food, and she probably won't shower for a few days.
Nobody would have ever imagined Emily would go on a trip like that — and that's the point!
"Plot twist trips" are among Booking.com's top travel predictions for 2027, according to a report by the travel platform.
The report looked at opinions from more than 28,000 travelers around the world to find out what travel trends are most likely to be popular next year.
The results showed that 77% of travelers would like to choose a vacation specifically to do something "completely out of character."
Booking.com said that, in a world of algorithms and constant connection, "plot twist trips" can help people take a break from the predictability of everyday life.

Around two-thirds of travelers said they want their next trip to surprise them in some way. And 36% are hoping to get a reaction from their friends and family by sharing pictures of themselves doing something out of the ordinary on their trip!

Another possible trend for 2027 is "social currency" — choosing whom to travel with based on whether they budget the way you do. Half of travelers in the report said they've reconsidered inviting certain people on trips because of differences in budgets or spending habits.

And many more people may be choosing their next vacation based on "vibes," according to the report. Eighty-one percent of travelers said they would choose a vacation not based on what they want to see, but how they want to feel.
And how some people may want to feel is scared — because almost two-thirds said they're interested in travel experiences that are paranormal in some way!
